## Cross-repo mesh — `langflow-sandbox-createos`

**Langflow integration**, one package of [`createos-plugin`](https://github.com/NodeOps-app/createos-plugin). Sandbox backend, canvas component and whole-flow executor. Talks to the REST API with `httpx`; no CLI and no SDK in the path.

### What ripples into this package

This package calls the REST API directly, so a control-plane wire change reaches it **without** touching the CLI or any SDK. It will not be caught by CLI or SDK checks.

**This package has no page in the public docs.** A user-visible change here has nowhere to land — flag that rather than shipping it undocumented.

The full repo graph, what counts as a shared surface, and the ripple
protocol live in the monorepo root [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md), which is
loaded automatically from this directory.
